slides.heading: Who Guides AI Agents?
slides.body: Sometimes AI needs a human to steer decisions or fix mistakes.

slides.caption: Humans provide insight AI can miss in complex situations.
Humans help ensure AI acts responsibly and fairly.
Humans catch errors AI agents might overlook or misinterpret.

slides.heading: Agentic AI + Humans = Smarter Together
slides.body: Keeping humans in the loop improves AI’s decisions and trustworthiness.
